Title: Bearing wear inspection
Body: Listen for a grinding or rough rumbling noise from the pump or its rotating shaft housing, feel for heat and play in the bearing, and replace it if worn.

Title: Belt tension adjustment
Body: Check drive belt deflection midway between the pulleys and tighten the tensioner until it is within specification.

Title: Hydraulic hose leak repair
Body: Depressurise the hydraulic system, locate the weeping fitting, replace the damaged hose and bleed out the air.

Title: Air compressor tank drain
Body: Open the receiver drain valve daily to remove condensate water from the tank.

Title: Intake filter replacement
Body: Remove the intake filter element, inspect it for dust clogging and fit a new element.

Title: Lockout tagout procedure
Body: Isolate all energy sources, apply personal locks and danger tags, and verify zero energy before starting work.

Title: Motor overheating diagnosis
Body: Check ventilation, measure the current draw and inspect the cooling fins for blockages.

Title: Gearbox oil change
Body: Drain the old lubricant while warm and refill with the specified gear oil up to the sight glass.

Title: Conveyor belt tracking
Body: Adjust the idler rollers so the belt runs centred on the frame.

Title: Boiler water level check
Body: Verify the gauge glass shows a normal water level and blow down the low water cutoff.

Title: Fire extinguisher inspection
Body: Check the pressure gauge is in the green zone, the seal is intact and the hose is undamaged; record it monthly.

Title: Emergency eyewash test
Body: Activate the eyewash station weekly and flush until the water runs clear.

Title: Forklift pre-start check
Body: Inspect tyres, forks, chains, horn, lights and hydraulic fluid before operating the truck.

Title: Pump seal replacement
Body: Replace the mechanical seal when liquid drips from the shaft gland.

Title: Pump cavitation troubleshooting
Body: When flow drops and vapour bubbles form at the impeller, check suction pressure and clean the inlet strainer.

Title: Switchboard thermal scan
Body: Use an infrared camera to find hot connections inside the electrical switchboard.

Title: Circuit breaker reset
Body: Identify the tripped breaker, find and fix the cause of the fault, then reset it.

Title: Generator load test
Body: Run the standby generator under load once a month for thirty minutes.

Title: Battery terminal cleaning
Body: Disconnect the leads, scrub corrosion from the battery posts with baking soda solution and apply terminal grease.

Title: Condenser coil cleaning
Body: Clean the condenser coil fins with a soft brush and coil cleaner.

Title: Refrigerant leak detection
Body: Use an electronic leak detector around the joints when the cooling system loses its charge.

Title: Thermostat calibration
Body: Compare the thermostat reading with a reference thermometer and adjust the offset.

Title: Chiller startup
Body: Open the water valves, start the chilled water pump, then start the chiller compressor.

Title: Cooling tower water treatment
Body: Test conductivity and dose biocide to control algae and legionella.

Title: Valve packing adjustment
Body: Tighten the gland nuts evenly when the valve stem weeps.

Title: Pressure relief valve test
Body: Lift the test lever to confirm the safety valve opens and reseats.

Title: Steam trap inspection
Body: Check the trap discharge with an ultrasonic tester; traps that fail open blow live steam.

Title: Welding machine setup
Body: Set the amperage for the rod size and attach the earth clamp close to the weld.

Title: Lathe chuck maintenance
Body: Clean and lubricate the chuck jaws and check for runout.

Title: Grinding wheel ring test
Body: Tap a new abrasive wheel and listen for a clear ring before mounting it.

Title: Compressed air leak survey
Body: Walk the air lines with an ultrasonic detector during quiet hours and tag every leak.

Title: Pipe insulation repair
Body: Replace damaged lagging on hot pipes to prevent heat loss and burns.

Title: Roof drain clearing
Body: Remove leaves and debris from the roof outlets before the wet season.

Title: Door closer adjustment
Body: Adjust the closing and latching speed valves so the door closes fully without slamming.

Title: Elevator pit inspection
Body: Check the lift pit for water, debris and the condition of the buffers.

Title: Light fitting relamping
Body: Replace failed lamps and dispose of the old tubes as hazardous waste.

Title: Emergency lighting test
Body: Simulate a mains failure and confirm the exit signs stay lit for ninety minutes.

Title: Water heater anode check
Body: Remove the sacrificial anode rod and replace it if heavily corroded.

Title: Backflow preventer test
Body: Test the testable backflow device every year with a differential pressure gauge.

Title: Sump pump float test
Body: Pour water into the pit and confirm the float switch starts the pump.

Title: Diesel fuel polishing
Body: Filter the stored diesel to remove water and microbial growth.

Title: Fan vibration analysis
Body: Measure vibration on the fan bearings; high readings indicate imbalance or misalignment.

Title: Shaft alignment
Body: Use a laser alignment tool to line up the motor and pump shafts.

Title: Roller chain lubrication
Body: Apply chain oil to the drive chains and check them for elongation.

Title: Vehicle tyre pressure check
Body: Check and inflate the vehicle tyres to the placard pressure while they are cold.

Title: Ladder inspection
Body: Inspect rungs, rails and feet before use and tag out any damaged ladder.

Title: Spill kit restock
Body: Check the spill kit contents and replace used absorbent pads.

Title: Scaffold tag check
Body: Confirm the scaffold has a current green tag before climbing.

Title: Solar panel cleaning
Body: Rinse dust from the photovoltaic panels in the early morning.

Title: UPS battery replacement
Body: Swap the end-of-life batteries in the uninterruptible power supply.
